evals.prompt: Program a liquid transfer on our Hamilton STAR using PyLabRobot: pick up tips, transfer 100 uL from a source 96-well plate to a destination plate, and drop tips.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-pylabrobot. Builds a LiquidHandler with STARBackend and a STARLetDeck (or STARDeck), places the tip rack and plates in carrier sites (TIP_CAR_480_A00, PLT_CAR_L5AC_A00) assigned to rails, awaits lh.setup(), picks up tips, moves 100 uL with aspirate/dispense list vols (or transfer from a single Well via plate.get_well with target_vols), then discards or returns the tips and stops the handler in a finally block. Suggests simulating first with LiquidHandlerChatterboxBackend.

assertions.value: Awaits the async calls, passes vols as lists, and ends with discard_tips()/return_tips() (or drop_tips with explicit tip spots) rather than a bare drop_tips().

evals.prompt: I need one protocol that runs liquid handling and then reads absorbance on a BMG CLARIOstar plate reader, all from the same Python script.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-pylabrobot. Imports PlateReader and CLARIOstarBackend from pylabrobot.plate_reading (installing pylabrobot[ftdi]), sets up the reader alongside the LiquidHandler in one async script, puts the plate in the reader (gripper move or assign_child_resource) before calling read_absorbance(wavelength=..., use_new_return_type=True), and stops both devices in a finally block.

assertions.value: Drives a PlateReader (CLARIOstarBackend, read_absorbance with a plate assigned to the reader) and a LiquidHandler from the same async script; does not call a non-existent PlateReader.set_temperature.

evals.prompt: Before I run anything on the real robot I want to simulate my PyLabRobot protocol and watch the deck state. How do I do that?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-pylabrobot. Routes to visualization/simulation: swap in the LiquidHandlerChatterboxBackend and attach a Visualizer (Visualizer(resource=lh); await vis.setup()) to watch tip presence and liquid volumes without physical hardware.

assertions.value: Uses a no-hardware simulation backend (LiquidHandlerChatterboxBackend) and starts the Visualizer to inspect deck state before running on hardware.

evals.prompt: Coordinate a workflow that uses a Hamilton heater-shaker and an Inheco incubator alongside the liquid handler, all controlled from one PyLabRobot script.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-pylabrobot. Uses HeaterShaker with HamiltonHeaterShakerBackend (through a HamiltonHeaterShakerBox or the STAR as interface) and an Inheco incubator from pylabrobot.storage (SCILABackend or the Inheco incubator-shaker stack), together with the LiquidHandler, calling set_temperature, shake(speed, duration), lock_plate, and the incubator's take_in_plate/fetch_plate_to_loading_tray.

assertions.value: Coordinates heater-shaker, incubator, and liquid handler with the pylabrobot 0.2 modules (heating_shaking, storage) instead of outdated paths such as pylabrobot.incubation or set_shake_rate.

evals.prompt: Write me a standard Opentrons OT-2 protocol with the official Protocol API v2 to do a PCR setup on the thermocycler module.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT invoke this skill; defers to alterlab-opentrons. The user explicitly wants an Opentrons-only protocol using the official Opentrons Protocol API v2, which the dedicated Opentrons skill handles more simply than PyLabRobot's vendor-agnostic layer.

evals.prompt: We have 20 designed binder sequences. Send them to Adaptyv Bio for expression and BLI binding measurements against our target.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT invoke this skill; defers to alterlab-adaptyv. The user is ordering assays from Adaptyv's foundry, not programming their own liquid handler with PyLabRobot.
